body:
# Hutter's Tech Mod
## About
This mod is a tech mod for making Minecraft more easy and fun.
It is still incomplete, so i am waiting for feedback and ideas from you !

## Features
-A new material Vibranite that is stronger than netherite and it is found in meteorites that are found in the Overworld.

-A new item, Hammer which let's you x2/x3/x4 the ores (diamond/netherite/vibranite).

## Dependencies
This mod has no dependencies.

JEI is recommended for recipes but not required.
